name: video-generator
description: Make a short, silent video of animated text over AI-generated images and color — a real MP4 sized for vertical, square, or widescreen posts — written from what you tell it, with no invented dates, prices, or claims. Then get a link to start a B12 website in the same colors.

interface.longDescription:
Tell it what the video is for and where you'll post it. It writes a short message, generates images to match, animates both in one of four styles, and hands over a silent MP4 sized for vertical, square, or widescreen posts, with a cover image.

No account needed. It can also give you a link to start a B12 website in the same colors.
defaultPrompt: Make a short promo video for my business
Create a 15-second video announcing our grand opening
Make a vertical video for social media
